resources.string: Complete eligible AI requests in this app with usage included in your ChatGPT plan or credits balance. Works with ChatGPT Plus and Pro. agentreins-moblie itself is free; nothing is charged by agentreins-moblie.
Finish signing in in your browser, then come back to agentreins-moblie.
Eligible usage in this app uses your ChatGPT plan. Manage usage in your ChatGPT settings.
Using ChatGPT plan. On Plus, the 5-hour limit is shared with other apps that use your plan; Pro has no 5-hour limit.
Signed out on this phone. Continue with ChatGPT to use your plan again; your model choices are kept.
Signed out on this phone, but ChatGPT didn’t confirm it. You can also disconnect agentreins-moblie in your ChatGPT settings.
Sign-in was cancelled. If the page said the required permission isn’t available: using your plan needs ChatGPT Plus or Pro. With a free account, add another provider’s API key instead.
